notes: Seed URL co.comal.tx.us/Elections.htm now redirects to comalcounty.gov; its Elections and Voter Registration page (193) links 'Election Results' to results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Comal/ and 'Past Election Results' (973). The 2024 general is on Clarity (EID 122856), read by phase1.clarity_timeline (9 of 15 versions 404, all before election day). From 2026 the county uses Enhanced Voting (app.enhancedvoting.com/results/public/comal-county-tx/...), which exposes only the current state through its public API (/results/public/api/elections/comal-county-tx/<election>: primary lastUpdated 2026-03-13T16:35:48Z isOfficialResults true; runoff lastUpdated 2026-06-04T22:19:29Z) and no dated update history, so check 1 cannot read election night for 2026. No county-posted election-night reports for 2026 were found on comalcounty.gov. 2026 primary and runoff are UNDETERMINED pending check 3 (wayback-data branch not found on origin). The current Enhanced Voting settings show precinctResultsProtected false and hidePrecincts false, but that is the post-canvass state, not election night.
tag_rationale: Only the 2024 general is determined (LIVE by check 1); both 2026 elections are UNDETERMINED. With exactly one election determined the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with low confidence.

2024_general.fact: Clarity EID 122856 night updates: 11/5/2024 7:55:34 PM CST (44 precincts with votes, early only), 9:36:10 PM (44; election-day votes in 42 precincts), 10:52:35 PM (45; election-day in 44), 11/6/2024 12:49:14 AM CST (75; adds absentee).

2026_primary.fact: Results on Enhanced Voting (https://app.enhancedvoting.com/results/public/comal-county-tx/elections/ComalCountyPrimary); API shows only the official state (lastUpdated 2026-03-13T16:35:48Z), no update history. Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: Results on Enhanced Voting (https://app.enhancedvoting.com/results/public/comal-county-tx/elections/ComalCountyPrimaryRunoff26); API shows only the final state (lastUpdated 2026-06-04T22:19:29Z), no update history. Check 3 pending.
